title: ChannelId
description:
A logical broadcast channel name. Case-sensitive and ASCII-only, so no Unicode normalization question exists for v1/v2 (ADR-0025) — two spellings differing only in case are two different channels, and they derive two different hashed wire topics.

The transport attaches NO application semantics to a ChannelId. It is not a room, a topic in the human sense, a permission scope, or a membership set; joining is a local subscription reference, and the backend may hide the raw name on the wire behind a deterministic domain-separated hash. That hash keeps casual names off the wire but does not resist dictionary guessing of a low-entropy name, which is a property of the construction rather than an oversight.
